nodes.label: Image.open()
nodes.desc: Lazy entry point: reads only a 16-byte prefix, identifies the format and defers every pixel read until load().

nodes.label: _decompression_bomb_check
nodes.desc: Rejects images larger than MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS (89478485 pixels, about a quarter gigabyte of 24-bit RGB) unless a warning is explicitly disabled.

nodes.label: preinit() / init()
nodes.desc: preinit imports BMP, GIF, JPEG, PPM and PNG; init() scans the full _plugins list on demand.

nodes.label: _plugins list
nodes.desc: 47 hardcoded plugin module names that init() walks with __import__.

nodes.label: OPEN / SAVE / ID dicts
nodes.desc: Module-level registries: ID lists formats, OPEN maps id to (factory, accept), SAVE/SAVE_ALL hold saver functions.

nodes.label: BmpImagePlugin
nodes.desc: Accepts the b'BM' magic, parses 12/40/52/56/64/108/124-byte headers and emits raw or bmp_rle tiles.

nodes.label: PngImagePlugin
nodes.desc: Chunk scanner that turns PNG data chunks into zip-decoder tiles.

nodes.label: JpegImagePlugin
nodes.desc: Marker-driven scanner (SOI, SOF, DHT) delegating entropy-coded data to libjpeg.

nodes.label: ImageFile.ImageFile
nodes.desc: Abstract base class for lazy plugins; subclasses fill self.tile during _open and pixels load later.

nodes.label: ImageFile.load()
nodes.desc: Sorts tiles in file order, optionally memory-maps single-tile raw files, then feeds byte blocks to decoders.

nodes.label: PyDecoder
nodes.desc: Pure-Python codec hook registered with register_decoder for formats like bmp_rle.

nodes.label: Image.core (_imaging)
nodes.desc: The C extension: ImagingNew allocates pixel buffers from a block arena with 4096-byte pages.
